mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in consumer demand (GDPC1) drives corporate earnings and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances despite sustained GDPC1 growth, or 60d returns fail to outperform a 5-year average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer demand (GDPC1) and labor participation (PAYEMS) signals robust economic expansion, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite simultaneous GDPC1 and PAYEMS growth, or IC < 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and compressing future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not remain above 2.0% for the full 5-day horizon, or 5d returns are positive despite the rate crossing above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, low unemployment (UNRATE <5.0%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL <2.0%) indicate peak growth, prompting market anticipation of stabilization and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during the regime conditions, or IC < 0.03 over any 12-month window in recovery periods.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in both consumer demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) reduces price pressures, sustaining corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite rising GDPC1 and INDPRO, or IC < 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in labor participation (PAYEMS crossing above 140) signals a strong labor market, boosting economic activity and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns are not positive despite PAYEMS crossing above 140, or IC < 0.03 over any 1-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In recession recovery, accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS <1.0%) and high unemployment (UNRATE >6.0%) signal easing inflationary pressures, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during recession recovery conditions, or IC < 0.03 over any 12-month window in recovery periods.
